hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for parkId 880226, read 2026-10-20: of 495 bookable campsites, 290 list 50-amp and 75 list 30-amp electric, 159 list a water hookup and 138 a sewer hookup (Tuttle mostly full-hookup, some in Jamestown); DCNR stay page: 'Some sites have full service hook up, which includes sewer, water, and electricity'

values.note: 495 bookable campsites across three campgrounds: Jamestown 308, Tuttle 107, Linesville 80 (137 full-hookup, 227 modern electric, 130 modern non-electric, one 3-unit Great Gathering site), plus 25 modern cabins, group tenting and glamping. Listed max vehicle lengths run 15 to 60 ft, most 30-45; 13 sites are pull-through.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/pymatuning-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880226 (site type counts) + every campsiteDetails page (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: All three campgrounds have showers, flush toilets and a sanitary dump station. The camp store and laundry (washers and dryers) are a concession at Jamestown Campground, generally open Memorial Day through Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/pymatuning-state-park/stay (Camping, and each campground's section) + ReserveAmerica site details ('Distance to Drinking Water: Less than 300 feet'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Pymatuning's booking page: campsites (full-hookup, modern electric, modern non-electric) 'can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance.' DCNR's park page: 'The maximum stay in all camping areas is 14 days during the summer season and 21 days during the off-season.'

summary: Confirmed season (mid-April to mid-October, all three campgrounds), reservable on ReserveAmerica with the 11-month window and the 14-night summer maximum. Added 50-amp electric with water and sewer at some sites, 495 campsites up to 60 ft with 13 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump/drinking water, Jamestown camp store and laundry. Fees left as recorded (human-checked 2026-10-12; park pages give no prices). Not stated for this park: same-day cutoff time, minimum stay, first-come policy. RA's 'Open year round' is the park (cabins), not the campgrounds.
